description: Check if a single email address is real and deliverable. Runs syntax, domain/MX, disposable, role-account, live SMTP mailbox, catch-all, SPF/DMARC and typo checks, and returns status (valid / invalid / risky / unknown), a 0-100 confidence score, reasons and a did_you_mean suggestion for likely typos. Takes 1-20 seconds.

email.description: The email address to verify, e.g. john.doe@company.com

name: verify_email
title: Verify email address
